title: Initial Code Oracle Characterization
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine, let $x$ be a bit string, and let $r,u\in\mathbb N$. The initial-code oracle on the paired input consisting of $x$ and the nested binary encodings of $u$ and $r$ accepts exactly when $u$ is the configuration code of $N$'s initial configuration on input $x$, using window parameter $r$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over bits
